title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, capturing noise and fluctuations that do not generalize to new data. This results in high variance.

title: Reducing Model Complexity
text: One way to reduce overfitting is to simplify the model by removing some features. This can help the model generalize better to unseen data.

title: Regularization Techniques
text: Using regularization techniques like L1 or L2 can help reduce overfitting by penalizing large coefficients in the model.

title: Cross-Validation
text: Implementing cross-validation can help in assessing how the model performs on different subsets of the data, providing a better estimate of its performance on unseen data.
